name: Pencil
headline: length
subtitle: Standard full-length wood-cased pencil
description: A wood-cased pencil is a graphite core glued inside a wooden barrel, usually hexagonal or round in cross-section. US pencil maker Musgrave lists its standard hex and round pencils at 7.5 in (190 mm) long and about 7 mm across. Pencils get shorter with every sharpening, so this is the length of a new one.

measures.label: Length (new)
measures.note: Standard full-length hex and round pencils, 7.5 in (190 mm), as listed by the manufacturer

measures.label: Barrel diameter
measures.note: Hexagonal pencil 0.275 in (7 mm) to round pencil 0.284 in (7.2 mm)

facts.text: Musgrave's carpenter pencils are shorter than a standard pencil at 7 in (178 mm), and its golf pencils are 3.0 in (76.2 mm) long.
Ticonderoga describes its standard #2 pencil as having a 9/32-inch diameter.

sources.title: Capabilities - Custom Pencils (pencil styles and sizes)

caveats: Dixon Ticonderoga's product pages and 2022 catalog list the standard pencil's length only as 'Standard' with no number, so the length comes from another US maker, Musgrave Pencil Company.
No manufacturer source for the weight of a pencil was found, so mass is left out.
